author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: किं चाहं विश्वनरसंबन्धितया वैश्वानरनामा जाठरवैश्वानरग्निस्थः सन् प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः प्राणापानाभ्यां मुख्यप्राणस्वरूपाभ्यां सम्यग्युक्तः भक्ष्यभोज्यलेह्यपेयभेदेन चतुर्विधं अन्नं पचामि जीर्णं करोमि ॥ १५.१४॥
translation:
Having become Vaiswanar and remaining in the body of all beings, attended by Prana and Apana, I digest the four kinds of food. (14.)
V. Vaiswanara : Vaiswanara by name on account of being connected with Viswa x Nara (all people) and being present in Agni called Vaiswanam, placed in every body's stomach. Prana and Amma: the two forms of Mukhya Prana. The four kinds of food: Bhakshya, to be eaten, Bhojya, to be swallowed; Lehya, to be tasted; Pêya, to be drunk. (14)
